home.gites_p: Each gîte is a 60 m² garden-level apartment in the house, with its own entrance, terrace and parking: a living room with fitted kitchen, two bedrooms with two beds each, and a wheelchair-accessible shower room. Both are laid out and equipped the same way, with the same view over the meadow.

home.hosts: Since 2007, the year we opened our gîtes, we have enjoyed sharing our way of life with guests from all over the world, and discovering theirs. It is our way of discovering other countries and cultures, and of showing others the riches of our region and country. Using German and English regularly is a pleasant change of scene.

domaine.lead: Two hectares of meadows on the edge of the forest, at a place called Vogelsgesang, and everything there is to see within an hour.
p: Set in a vast, green two-hectare estate on the edge of the forest, our two gîtes occupy the lower floor of a spacious house in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang” — birdsong.
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings offer lush nature and a beautiful panorama, in an atmosphere of calm and serenity.
There are many walking trails, reachable without crossing a road, on foot or by bike. Our horses, now retired, will watch you go by from the meadow.

reservation.access_h: Getting to the Domaine du Geisberg
access: Varsberg lies between Saint-Avold and Creutzwald, 40 minutes from Metz and 30 minutes from Saarbrücken.
By car: A4 motorway (Paris–Strasbourg), exit Saint-Avold / Carling, then towards Creutzwald and Varsberg.
By train: Saint-Avold station, 15 km away (TER Metz–Forbach).
